title: galatella iberica
intro: Galatella iberica, commonly known as the Spanish knapweed, is a perennial plant species in the family Asteraceae. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine, offering several health benefits such as reducing inflammation and relieving digestive issues. The plant's therapeutic actions include antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Galatella iberica include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
